title: Warm British Eggs Scotch Egg
description: A citrusy and light British dish featuring green curry paste, perfect for a brunch mood, made with paleo-friendly ingredients and wood-fired baked to perfection, formed into a scotch egg.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the green curry paste, coconut oil, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork sausage meat to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Wrap each egg in the sausage meat mixture, making sure to seal the egg completely.
Place the scotch eggs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the scotch eggs in the wood-fired oven for 20 minutes, or until the sausage meat is cooked through.
Remove the scotch eggs from the oven and sprinkle with lemon zest and chopped parsley.
Serve the scotch eggs warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
